info.description:
The REST API of OpenDevTrack: the one its screens use. Guide: docs/api.md.

Clients send a Keycloak access token in `Authorization: Bearer` (their own, or that of a service account) and may choose the tenant with `X-Tenant`; the screens use the session cookie. Within 1.x no public path or field is removed or renamed; paths marked `x-internal` serve only a screen and may change.
